note: Soul Collector (docs/SOUL_COLLECTOR_MAP.md, approved 2026-10-13). Each soul type has two forms: B = the BG3 creature itself (its own attacks from its template; new skills at 3 and 5 souls) and F = the FFT monster (family skills at 1, 3 and 5 souls). tools/build.py generates the form statuses (POLYMORPHED on Wild Shape's rule), the transform spells and the skills. match: lower-case Lua patterns tried on the dead creature's template name, stats id and display name (%f frontier patterns keep 'imp' out of 'impersonation'); exclude: patterns that rule a type out. hp: max HP per character level added to the form. Templates: vanilla root templates (Wild Shape player templates where one exists; else the creature's own, from the level data).
hpNote: A form takes its template's hit points (templateHp = the template stats' Vitality, checked by tools/check_souls.py); the body's share is clamped to hpRange (Wild Shape's Act 1 forms have 13-65: dire wolf 18, Moon owlbear 65), then hp x level is added.
